purpose: Test whether two already-frozen Dual Momentum return streams vary with three ex-ante market states, without changing either strategy or searching condition thresholds.

strategies.label: Dual Momentum Optimized 63D/Daily
strategies.evidenceGuard: Historically selected development candidate. It cannot earn a stable-regime classification from this sample; all historical conditional findings are exploratory and selection-contaminated.

executionTreatment.primary: Apply the same aggregate fill-ratio and incremental-slippage approximation used by the frozen prop study, with calibration values frozen above.

strategies.label: Canonical Dual Momentum 189D/Monthly
strategies.source: portfolio_runs.id=26 and registered Dual Momentum defaults
strategies.universePolicy: Point-in-time Dow membership schedule used by the canonical runner.
strategies.executionTreatment: Retain the registered per-symbol spread/cost model. Do not transfer small-cap optimized-DM fill calibration to the Dow universe.

conditions.definition: SPY adjusted close at T-1 is strictly above its 200-session simple moving average through T-1.
conditions.informationBoundary: Uses no observation later than the close of T-1 for strategy return T.

conditions.definition: SPY 21-session annualized realized volatility through T-1 is above the median of its preceding 252 realized-volatility observations, excluding T-1.
conditions.informationBoundary: The current volatility estimate and its reference distribution are both known by the close of T-1.

conditions.definition: The cross-sectional standard deviation of constituent close-to-close returns at T-1 is above the median of the preceding 63 dispersion observations, excluding T-1. Membership is the frozen fixed universe for Optimized DM and the point-in-time Dow membership for Canonical DM.
conditions.informationBoundary: No T prices enter the state applied to return T.

primaryHypotheses.family: Each of two strategies crossed with each of three binary conditions.
primaryHypotheses.estimand: Mean daily strategy return in state one minus mean daily strategy return in state zero.
primaryHypotheses.direction: Two-sided; no favorable state is declared in advance.

inference.multipleTesting: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all six primary interaction tests.
inference.stableCandidateRule: q <= 0.10, 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes zero, both states have at least 63 observations, at least three calendar years contribute, and at least 80% of usable leave-one-year-out estimates share the full-sample direction.
inference.optimizedOverride: Optimized DM is always capped at exploratory_historical regardless of statistical results because its sample selected this configuration.

reportedMetrics: mean, median, annualized mean, volatility, Sharpe, hit rate, worst day, cumulative return, and maximum drawdown by state
state-one minus state-zero daily mean and annualized difference
moving-block bootstrap confidence interval and p-value
missing-condition observations and point-in-time membership diagnostics

prospectiveExtension.start: First completed market session strictly after 2026-08-26
prospectiveExtension.storage: Append-only daily regime labels linked to the existing locked optimized strategy fingerprint.
prospectiveExtension.orders: Observation only. Regime labels cannot suppress, resize, create, modify, or cancel an order.
prospectiveExtension.historicalSeparation: Prospective labels and returns are never pooled into the historical discovery result.

prohibitions: No threshold, lookback, state definition, strategy parameter, universe, holding, rebalance, leverage, or cost model may be selected after seeing conditional results.
No conditional strategy or live trading filter is created by this audit.
No subgroup Sharpe alone can qualify a condition; the interaction estimand and preregistered stability gates control interpretation.
No annualized or long-history claim is made for the optimized strategy's approximately one-year selected sample.
Canonical and optimized results remain separate; they are not pooled as independent replications.
